notes.title: Save 50% to celebrate Wanderlust: Travel Stories trading cards!
notes.content:
A fun thing about travelling is collecting SOUVENIRS! And we bring you the closest thing you can have in a video game about globetrotting.  

[h3]Wanderlust trading cards, badges, emojis, and free wallpapers, are now available on Steam![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37200888/df5405e383a7f59ab107a17aa2ffe28673e7dd08.jpg[/img]

And if you don't own the game yet, we have 50-60% discounts on the titles in the series. Happy trails!
